note: Majority: the Civil Code (ՀՀ Քաղաքացիական օրենսգիրք, HO-239 of 5 May 1998, latest incorporation on ARLIS), article 24(1): full civil capacity from majority, that is from turning eighteen; article 24(2) lets a minor of 16 who works under an employment contract or runs a business with consent be declared fully capable (emancipation), and marriage gives capacity too; neither is held. Work: the Labour Code (HO-124-N of 9 November 2004, English text on ARLIS as amended to HO-525-N of 4 December 2024), article 17.1: a person under sixteen may be engaged only on a temporary contract and not in permanent employment, so the form holds 16 for general employment (14 to 16 temporary work, not held); a person under fourteen may be engaged only in creating or performing works in cinema, sports, theatre, concert organisations, circus, television or radio. The Code names no permit for that, so performers are free (parental consent and hours limits aren't held). Service: the Law on Military Service and the Status of Servicemen of 15 November 2017 conscripts men from 18 to 27 (reserve officers to 35), as the Belgian asylum office's country report of 27 June 2024 states it (ARLIS's copy of the law wasn't found by its act number); women serve only as volunteers. The term was 24 months; the National Assembly adopted in second reading a law cutting it to 18 months for those called up after 1 January 2026 (Armenpress, the state news agency, 16 December 2025); the amended text itself wasn't read. Military registration and the 2024 option for men over 27 to serve briefly or pay aren't held.

sources.title: ARLIS: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia (English)
sources.said: 2. Persons under the age of fourteen may be involved only in creating or performing compositions (creative work) in cinematographic, sports, theatrical or concert organisations, circus, television or radio. 3. A temporary employment contract shall be concluded with persons under the age of sixteen. Admitting persons under the age of sixteen for permanent employment shall be prohibited.

sources.title: CGRS (Belgium), COI Focus Armenia: Military service and military criminal cases, 27 June 2024
sources.said: The Law of the Republic of Armenia on the Status of Military Service and Servicemen of 15 November 2017 stipulates that Armenian men are conscripted from the age of 18 to 27, except for reserve officers who can be called up until the age of 35.

sources.title: Armenpress: National Assembly approves 18-month compulsory military service (16 December 2025)
sources.said: the duration of compulsory military service will be reduced from 24 months to 18 months (1.5 years). The changes will apply to citizens drafted for compulsory military service after January 1, 2026.
